gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-oxygen: Wide-spaced and stately, with a midline set high. Metamorphous loses its commanding swagger if shrunk small, while Oxygen would only look oversized and loose if enlarged past text size.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-preahvihear: Charcoal-soft and commanding, Metamorphous sets wide-spaced letters with a high midline and a faint pressure shadow in the curves. Metamorphous makes an entrance; Preahvihear, tall and open-mouthed, does the steady talking.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-puritan: Puritan reads friendly and rounded, with generous oversized counters. Metamorphous is best at commanding attention with its high midline and slightly slimmer horizontals, while Puritan is best at quietly carrying the text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-questrial: Regal and wide-spaced, Metamorphous sets a high midline and a measured, thread-against-yarn gap between fat and slim strokes. Questrial, a sans-serif, runs on flat and uniform, without a single swelling curve.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-tiktok-sans: Expressive from the first letter, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like, uniform strokes. Funnel Display is best at stopping the eye; TikTok Sans, whose x-height rises close to cap height, is best at keeping it moving.
gen-gf-offside-fs-bespoke-sans: Wide-tracked and open-curved, Offside holds a level beat with no swell on any downstroke. Bespoke Sans does the finer work, with a moderate lowercase and generous space where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-bangla: Commanding yet quiet, Offside lays out widely tracked, thin-looking letters with no thinner parts. And Anek Bangla, with wide, barely curled s curves, would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-offside-gf-athiti: Wide-tracked and level, Offside leads with a quiet beat. Their single best quality is shared openness: Offside's unclosed curves, and in Athiti, a see-through gap in each s plus single-width lines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible has clipped capitals and ascenders, with wide-set terminals on its s. Beneath Offside's untapered, quill-free heading, paragraphs feel friendly and unhurried, each line easing into the next.
gen-gf-offside-gf-biryani: Offside is wide-tracked and commanding, its curves refusing to close and no stroke ever swelling or thinning. Biryani then reads clear and unclogged, with a large eye on every e.
